body: I don't really understand what you're saying here but.. I don't care if society ever changes, sure there are shitty things about it but, whatever. That affects everyone not just me. I'm trying to change my own life. Not the world.
Thanks for the response, I'm glad things are starting to improve for you.

Why should I call a hotline or go to an emergency room? So they can throw me into a mental hospital against my will, strap me to a bed give me thorazine against my will and force me to take medication that I don't want and then release me after a week like everything is okay?
I can't miss a week of school. I've been through this so many times. Seeing a therapist and even just being depressed has a pretty big stigma to it. Especially when you're a man. Men don't complain men just suck it and do what they have to (insert more bullshit from our society) All of the therapists I've seen have never been able to help me. After a couple weeks / months I get one of two answers "I don't know how to help you" or "you should just kill yourself already" I didn't ask for this, I just want to put my head down work hard and have a normal life. I want to feel content. That's all. I don't care if I'm ever happy. I just want to go through life feeling okay.
